theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_valence_pseudohyperbolic_disks
theorems.statement: let D : ℂ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun v ε => {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im ∧ ‖(z - v) / (z - star v)‖ ≤ ε}; ∀ (v : ℂ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < v.im → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → D v ε = Metric.closedBall ((v.re : ℂ) + ((v.im * (1 + ε ^ 2) / (1 - ε ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * v.im * ε / (1 - ε ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ a b c d : ℝ, a * d - b * c = 1 → let M : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((a : ℂ) * z + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * z + (d : ℂ)); M '' (D v ε) = D (M v) ε
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted Euclidean-disk description and Möbius-image lemmas under the unchanged hypotheses.
